content.comment_body: I'm new to this forum and couldn't find how to make a general post. I need some guidance as a beginner. I recently purchased a [product_name] Starter Kit, which includes an HMI and a PLC. The kit contains only one power supply adapter, and I'm unsure if I need to buy a separate power supply for either the HMI or PLC, or if it's fine to use the single power supply for both devices since it's just for basic learning. I couldn't find information in the manuals or on the [company_name] support site. Thanks in advance for your help.
No additional power supply is needed. The HMI requires 0.1 A, the PLC needs 0.09 A at 24VDC, while the power supply unit provides up to 1.3 A. This leaves over 1 A available for other uses.
Thank you for the helpful response. I was able to successfully connect both devices. Best regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: New users are unsure whether the single power supply in the [product_name] Starter Kit can support both the HMI and PLC simultaneously. Since the manuals and [company_name] support site do not provide clear instructions, confusion arises. Prompt advice from another user resolves the issue, confirming that the included power supply is sufficient for both devices, with considerable capacity remaining.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward information about whether the starter kit’s supplied power supply is capable and safe for powering both the PLC and HMI at once.
